About Us

We are here – always for you: Our company motto stands not only for satisfied customers but also for happy employees. For over 35 years, we have been an internationally oriented, independent logistics service provider with a future-oriented approach. We offer jobs for approximately 400 employees at 19 locations in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Mexico, the USA, Vietnam, and China. Additionally, we are connected to 156 exclusive logistics partners at all key locations worldwide.

As experienced order processors and project logisticians, our colleagues have made the TCI Group a powerful and progressive company in the international freight forwarding industry. Every day, they work to ensure that our company continues to grow together with them.

To strengthen our team in Rotterdam, we are looking for
Freight Forwarding Clerks (m/f/d) – Sea Freight Export and Import (LCL / FCL)
in a full-time, permanent position with flexible working hours, starting as soon as possible.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Independent order processing in the area of sea freight export and sea freight import
- Autonomous customer support and development in collaboration with supervisors
- Correspondence with our international customers and logistics partners via phone and email
- Scheduling, customs clearance, documentation and invoicing

Your profile

- Experience as a Freight Forwarding Clerk in the field of freight forwarding, logistics and sea freight
- Knowledge of customs regulations and customs clearance is desirable
- Proficient in industry-standard software and MS Office
- Good Dutch and English skills, both written and spoken

What we offer you

- A secure job with a permanent employment contract
- Good work-life balance through flexible working hours
- Option to work remotely from home
- International work environment and modern equipment
- Internal training and support for external training programs in freight forwarding (import/export)
- Events and benefit programs for employees

Do you recognize yourself in this profile?

We are looking forward to receiving your application in English along with a letter of motivation, CV and references.

If you have any questions please visit our website: https://www.mytcigroup.com

Or give us a call: +49 4041364498

You can find us at this address: TCI International Logistics B. V., Hoefsmidstraat 41, Unit E1.12, 3194 Hoogvliet, Rotterdam
